stopPoints.label: Peppa introduces Daddy Pig
stopPoints.question:
Question (Observation): 'Look at Daddy Pig! What color are his glasses?'
Options: 'A) Black 👓 B) Red 🔴'
Guidance: Guide the child to say: 'They are black!'

stopPoints.label: Arriving at the beach
stopPoints.question:
Question (Location): 'Where is Peppa's family now?'
Guidance: Encourage the child: 'They are at the beach! 🏖️'

stopPoints.label: Unpacking the beach items
stopPoints.question:
Question (Object Recognition): 'What did Peppa take out from the basket?'
Options: 'A) Buckets and spades 🪣 B) Books and pens 📚'
Guidance: Prompt the child: 'Buckets and spades!'

stopPoints.label: Applying sun cream
stopPoints.question:
Question (Why/Reason): 'Why do Peppa and George need sun cream?'
Guidance: Guide the child to say: 'Because the sun is very hot! ☀️'

stopPoints.label: Daddy Pig tests the ball
stopPoints.question:
Question (Pattern/Colors): 'Look at the ball. What does it have on it?'
Options: 'A) Stripes B) Colorful spots ⚪'
Guidance: Say: 'It has colorful spots! It is a spotty ball!'

stopPoints.label: George misses the ball
stopPoints.question:
Question (Yes/No): 'Can George catch the ball?'
Options: 'A) Yes, he can. B) No, he cannot.'
Guidance: Encourage the child: 'No, he is too little to catch it!'

stopPoints.label: George wears water wings
stopPoints.question:
Question (Color): 'Look at George's arms. What color are his water wings?'
Options: 'A) Yellow 🟡 B) Blue 🔵'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'They are yellow!'

stopPoints.label: Peppa gets ready for the water
stopPoints.question:
Question (Action): 'Peppa and George have their water wings on. Where are they going?'
Guidance: Say: 'They are going into the sea! 🌊'

stopPoints.label: Touching the water
stopPoints.question:
Question (Temperature): 'Daddy Pig says the water is not cold. How does it feel?'
Guidance: Elicit the phrase: 'It's lovely and warm!'

stopPoints.label: Splashing in the sea
stopPoints.question:
Question (Action): 'What are they doing in the water?'
Options: 'A) Splashing water 💦 B) Sleeping 😴'
Guidance: Encourage the child to make splashing motions and say: 'They are splashing! Splash, splash!'

stopPoints.label: Peppa asks to bury Daddy Pig
stopPoints.question:
Question (Polite Manners): 'Peppa asks Daddy to play. What polite word does she say?'
Guidance: Prompt the child: 'Please! She says, "Please, Daddy!"'

stopPoints.label: Daddy Pig buried in the sand
stopPoints.question:
Question (Body Parts): 'Daddy Pig is covered in sand! Which part of Daddy can you still see?'
Guidance: Ask the child to touch their own head and say: 'His head!'

stopPoints.label: Daddy Pig gets his straw hat
stopPoints.question:
Question (Clothing): 'What did George put on Daddy Pig's head?'
Options: 'A) A straw hat 👒 B) A crown 👑'
Guidance: Say: 'A straw hat!'

stopPoints.label: Daddy Pig falls asleep
stopPoints.question:
Question (Action/Yes-No): 'Listen! Daddy Pig is snoring. Is he sleeping?'
Options: 'A) Yes, he is. B) No, he isn't.'
Guidance: Encourage the child: 'Yes, he is having a little sleep! Shh...'

stopPoints.label: Making sandcastles
stopPoints.question:
Question (Tool & Color): 'Peppa has a green bucket. What color is George's bucket?'
Options: 'A) Orange 🟠 B) Pink 🌸'
Guidance: Help the child answer: 'It is orange!'

stopPoints.label: Sandcastles with flags
stopPoints.question:
Question (Count & Colors): 'How many sandcastles did they make? And what color is Peppa's flag?'
Guidance: Guide the child to count: 'Two sandcastles! 🏰 And Peppa has a red flag!'

stopPoints.label: Checking the beach stuff
stopPoints.question:
Question (Routine): 'Mummy Pig packed the bag. Is it time to play or home time?'
Guidance: Say: 'It is home time! 🚗'

stopPoints.label: Finding the straw hat
stopPoints.question:
Question (Memory/Humor): 'Mummy thinks they forgot the hat. But who is under the hat?'
Guidance: Prompt the child with a laugh: 'Daddy Pig! They forgot Daddy Pig!'
